reviews.title: Attractive RGB Edging; High Performing Memory As Labelled
reviews.comment: This pair of RAM sticks are on my motherboard's QVL so they work well in this dual configuration, in the 2nd and 4th slots. RGB lighting on top edge goes well with my Corsair iCue Link fans and AIO. Sturdy casing and memory that I anticipate lasting as long as this PC.
reviews.author: Rudy

reviews.title: Great value and fast shipper
reviews.comment: I recently purchased this product. I found it to be a great product. It is made sturdy and works well. It is easy to use and looks great. The price was fair and the item was as described in the ad.

reviews.comment: Amazing 10/10! Build quality was amazing and very easy to install! Very easy over clock on ASUS tuf Overall very good component paired with I9-14900k
reviews.author: Rage

reviews.title: Gorgeous!
reviews.comment: This is my third set of AM5 RAM for this computer, AM5 has been one of the most unstable platforms I've ever had, so I went through one set of trident z and another brand that I can't remember the name right now and they both died literally on my computer, stoped the computer from working, wouldn't boot up! This ram has performed exceptionally and it's gorgeous, the color profiles inside the software that you get from these guys awesome! It's stable and it just works, still having some stability issues on sleep mode, every time I go into sleep mode when I Wake the computer it wants to reboot so it's not saving the profiles properly and that's been a problem since I started the am5 platform so I don't think it's a ram problem I think it's something else, I do have a Ryzen 7800 x3d, and a AMD 7900xt GPU they work well together.
reviews.author: Charles Leffew
